review.subtitle: Tissot Gentleman Powermatic 80 Open Heart 40 mm, grey dial, steel bracelet. Front relief GLB, round 2: dial print redrawn sharp at 4x, batons with a sloped frame and brushed channel.
specs: lug gap in the render (21 official)
notes: Built from Tissot's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled; it is kept as the 3/4 reference). The official render shows the dial grey-taupe; the supplied photo looks more champagne under warmer light.

Modelled: polished case with the wide curved bezel, applied batons (polished frame sloping into a darker brushed channel), faceted hour and minute hands with lume strips and kite tails, thin seconds hand, fluted crown, brushed lugs, bracelet with brushed outer links and polished centre pieces, house curl.

From the photo map: sunray dial, minute track, lume dots, TISSOT 1853, Powermatic 80, Swiss Made and the open-heart movement. Round 2: the black print is redrawn sharp at 4x the render's resolution (2720 px map), so it stays crisp in the dial close-up.
Heights are a front-relief reading of the official 11.5 mm case.
